cards.ex: Before launching the project, we need to address all ethical considerations.
cards.exUz: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin, biz barcha axloqiy mulohazalarni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror vaziyatda axloqiy tamoyillarni hisobga olish.

cards.ex: He showed his moral fiber by refusing to participate in the scheme.
cards.exUz: U sxemada ishtirok etishdan bosh tortib, o'zining axloqiy tolalarini ko'rsatdi.

cards.ex: For her, refusing to lie was a matter of conscience.
cards.exUz: U uchun yolg'on gapirishdan bosh tortish vijdon ishi edi.

cards.ex: The company's actions demonstrated a complete moral bankruptcy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning harakatlari to'liq axloqiy bankrotlikni ko'rsatdi.

cards.ex: We must uphold values like honesty and integrity.
cards.exUz: Biz halollik va yaxlitlik kabi qadriyatlarni himoya qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Sometimes, your moral compass wavers when you're under pressure.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan, bosim ostida bo'lganingizda, axloqiy yo'nalishingiz yo'qoladi.

cards.ex: If they lie about this, they will lose credibility with the public.
cards.exUz: Agar ular bu haqda yolg'on gapirsalar, ular jamoatchilik bilan ishonchni yo'qotadilar.

cards.ex: Companies have a social responsibility to protect the environment.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish bo'yicha ijtimoiy mas'uliyatga ega.

cards.ex: He was in a moral quandary about whether to report his friend.
cards.exUz: U do'stini xabar qilish yoki qilmaslik haqida axloqiy dilemada edi.

cards.ex: The lawyer was found to be in breach of ethics.
cards.exUz: Advokat axloq qoidalarini buzganligi aniqlandi.

cards.ex: She tries to live by values like compassion and kindness.
cards.exUz: U rahm-shafqat va mehribonlik kabi qadriyatlar bilan yashashga harakat qiladi.

cards.ex: The company developed an ethical framework to guide its employees.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xodimlarga yo'l-yo'riq ko'rsatish uchun axloqiy asos ishlab chiqdi.

cards.ex: He had no sense of decency, making offensive jokes.
cards.exUz: Uning odoblilik hissi yo'q edi, haqoratli hazillar qilardi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri xulq-atvor va axloqiy me'yorlarga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: He achieved success at the expense of his health.
cards.exUz: U sog'lig'i evaziga muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

cards.ex: We have a moral imperative to help those in need.
cards.exUz: Bizning muhtojlarga yordam berish bo'yicha axloqiy zaruratimiz bor.

cards.ex: He refused to compromise his principles, even under pressure.
cards.exUz: U bosim ostida ham o'z tamoyillaridan voz kechishni rad etdi.

cards.ex: It's a question of ethics whether to use that technology.
cards.exUz: Bu texnologiyadan foydalanish axloq masalasidir.

cards.ex: I can say with a clear conscience that I did my best.
cards.exUz: Men toza vijdon bilan ayta olamanki, men qo'limdan kelganicha harakat qildim.

cards.ex: From an ethical standpoint, this decision is unacceptable.
cards.exUz: Axloqiy nuqtai nazardan, bu qaror qabul qilinishi mumkin emas.

cards.ex: It might be hard, but we need to do the ethical thing.
cards.exUz: Qiyin bo'lishi mumkin, lekin biz axloqiy ishni qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy tamoyillarga mos ravishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His actions showed that he lacks integrity.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari uning halollik yo'qligini ko'rsatdi.

cards.ex: My moral compass points me towards helping others.
cards.exUz: Mening axloqiy kompasim menga boshqalarga yordam berishga yo'naltiradi.

cards.ex: His actions were a serious breach of trust.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari jiddiy ishonchni suiiste'mol qilish edi.

cards.ex: We all have a moral responsibility to protect the planet.
cards.exUz: Hammamizning sayyoramizni himoya qilish bo'yicha axloqiy javobgarligimiz bor.

cards.ex: We need to consider the moral implications of this decision.
cards.exUz: Biz bu qarorning axloqiy oqibatlarini ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Having a good team helps keep each other honest.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi jamoaga ega bo'lish bir-birini halol bo'lishga majbur qiladi.

cards.ex: The company is known for its high ethical standards.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yuqori axloqiy standartlari bilan mashhur.

cards.ex: We need to take a stand against injustice.
cards.exUz: Biz adolatsizlikka qarshi pozitsiyani egallashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga nisbatan qat'iy fikr bildirish.

cards.ex: He felt he was on firm moral ground.
cards.exUz: U o'zini mustahkam axloqiy asosda his qildi.

cards.ex: I refused to lie; it was a matter of principle.
cards.exUz: Men yolg'on gapirishdan bosh tortdim; bu tamoyil masalasi edi.
